operating_notes.text: Sanctions ₹2,527 Cr and disbursements ₹2,299 Cr in FY26, up 32% and 29% respectively.
Gross NPA portfolio ₹445 Cr (3.96%) and net NPA ₹177 Cr (1.61%) as on 31-03-2026.
Cost of borrowed funds 7.84% in FY26 versus 8.22% in FY25; yield on advances 9.65% versus 9.95%.
Benchmark Prime Lending Rate (BPLR) increased from 17.70% to 17.95% effective November 1, 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹272.7 Cr (+0.4% YoY), net profit ₹53.68 Cr (+52.5% YoY).

GIC Housing Finance approved a 25 bps increase in its Benchmark Prime Lending Rate to 17.95% effective November 1, 2026.
